[[hcell colspan="3"]]
Viola
[[/hcell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell colspan="3"]]
A pet that is best for soloing, as it has an effective hate generation, unlike the Launcher PA Fake Silhouette. Bosses will even more likely to target Viola rather than other people in an EQ. Viola's regular PA are similar to Wanda, albeit lacking a reliable area attack. Viola's stats are not very impressive, and this including their defense. Using Viola Change, however, increases their defense and changes how their PA works: exerting high-powered damage, high DPS, and enormous hit box in expense of slower animation and sluggish PP regeneration. Due to how Change mechanic works, Viola is the only pet that gets stronger by using Liberate Takt.

Viola is the signature pet of Manaka.

Personality Description
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Show-off (目立ちたがり Poser//) Takes 10% less damage and makes hate generation even more effective. This is the preferred personality.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Soothing (いやし系) Increases healing rate of all unsummoned pets. Does not affect stunned pets.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Elegant (エレガント) ★14 only. Combines Show-off and Soothing, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

[[cell class="pros-cons-list pros w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Attracts enemies
  • High-powered normal attacks
  • High PP regain from normal attack
  • High-powered PAs
  • Wide area PAs
  • Highest DoT PA
  • Has an attack that Stuns
  • Efficient PP usage
  • Normal attack has a big hitbox
  • PAs have big hitboxes

[[/cell]]
[[cell class="pros-cons-list cons w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Unsuitable for newbies
  • Requires use of Viola Change to choose between regain PP or doing high damage
  • Mediocre DEF if not in Change state
  • Slow PA animation
  • Have problems with moving enemies.

1 DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better.
2 Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks. Hold is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button. Auto is the number if you let the pet attack freely. If only Hold exists, then the pet will do less if you don't hold the button. The number in bracket is the restored PP per second, disregarding natural PP regen.
3 Overall DPS Rating: The greater the number, the greater the pet's DPS potential is. This is calculated by using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during standard case scenario: Phantom sub, enemy is weak to pet's element, enemy isn't moving, a pair of 110% damage parfaits, using PA to deplete 200PP, then use Normal Attacks to get back 200PP (boosted natural PP regen and attack PP regen due to Phantom sub is calculated).
4 Sweets in bold are currently what Manaka put on her pets. For more information about Sweets, see the [#recommended-candies Recommended Sweets] Section.

7 Higher efficiency means lower PP consumption. An efficiency of 100 means you can sustain the attack for a long time. Remember that the most efficient attack doesn't mean that it will do decent DPS.
